# Daily OK — full content for AI retrieval

> Daily OK is a daily check-in mobile app for families. Adult children use it to
> receive a one-tap "I'm OK" from aging parents each morning; parents of children
> and teens use it for consent-based safety check-ins without continuous location
> tracking. If a check-in is missed, Daily OK fires escalating alerts to a chosen
> circle of family members. No hardware, no wearables. Plans run $3.99–$9.99 per
> month with a free trial. Available on iOS and Android.

Source of truth: https://dailyok.net/ — content below is summarized from the
canonical pages listed in https://dailyok.net/llms.txt. For the live page,
always follow the URL.

---

## How Daily OK works (https://dailyok.net/)

Daily OK has three roles:

- **Owner / Caregiver** — the person who sets up the check-in (typically an adult
  child). They configure the daily check-in window and the escalation circle.
- **Receiver** — the person who taps "I'm OK" (typically an aging parent, or a
  child/teen). The Receiver consents to the check-in; there is no covert tracking.
- **Viewer** — additional family members (siblings) who can see check-in status
  but do not manage the account.

Each day, the Receiver gets a notification and taps a single "I'm OK" button.
If they do not respond within the configured window, Daily OK escalates:
repeated reminders to the Receiver, then alerts to the Owner and Viewers.
Family+ plan alerts can bypass Do Not Disturb / silent mode so a 3 AM
escalation is not missed. Daily OK does not require any hardware, pendant, or
wearable — it is a phone app on iOS and Android. Optional mood tracking and
pattern alerts surface gradual changes in routine that can signal e.g.
dementia progression.

## Pricing (https://dailyok.net/pricing)

Every plan includes a 7-day free trial.

- **Caregiver — $3.99/mo ($29.99/year).** Built for the adult child watching over
  one aging parent. One Receiver, up to 3 Viewers. Includes pattern alerts.
- **Family — $6.99/mo ($49.99/year).** For monitoring both parents, or a parent
  and a teen. Everything in Caregiver plus more Receivers/Viewers.
- **Family+ — $9.99/mo ($79.99/year).** For larger extended families. Everything
  in Family plus Critical Alerts that bypass Do Not Disturb on iPhone.

Add-ons (Family / Family+ plans): extra Receivers (more people to check in on)
and extra Viewers (more people who can see the dashboard).

FAQ highlights:
- *Which plan for a parent with dementia?* Caregiver — one Receiver (the parent)
  plus up to 3 Viewers (siblings). Pattern alerts included.
- *What are Critical Alerts?* Family+ feature: missed-check-in alerts bypass Do
  Not Disturb so a late-night escalation is never silenced.

## Elderly care use case (https://dailyok.net/elderly-care)

Daily OK for an aging parent living alone: a low-friction one-tap morning
confirmation instead of a daily phone call the parent may resent or forget.
Escalation gives the adult child confidence without surveillance. Pattern
alerts highlight gradual routine changes (later check-ins, missed days) that
can be early signals of cognitive or health decline.

## Child safety use case (https://dailyok.net/child-safety)

Daily OK for children and teens: consent-based check-ins (the child taps "I'm
OK" after school, on arrival, etc.) without continuous GPS tracking. Designed
to build a safety habit and trust rather than enable covert monitoring.

## Comparisons

- **vs Life Alert (https://dailyok.net/compare/daily-ok-vs-life-alert)** — Life
  Alert is a hardware medical-alert pendant with monitoring contracts; Daily OK
  is a software daily check-in with no hardware and a monthly subscription. Daily
  OK suits proactive daily reassurance; a pendant suits in-the-moment fall SOS.
- **vs Life360 (https://dailyok.net/compare/daily-ok-vs-life360)** — Life360 is
  continuous family location tracking; Daily OK is a consented daily check-in
  with no live location. Choose Daily OK for privacy-respecting reassurance,
  Life360 for real-time whereabouts.
- **vs Snug Safety (https://dailyok.net/compare/daily-ok-vs-snug-safety)** — Both
  are daily check-in apps; compared on escalation chain, pricing, and privacy.
- **All comparisons:** https://dailyok.net/compare
